en.headline: Over 70,000 subdivided units registered in first six months
en.dek: Housing Secretary Winnie Ho said applications as of 31 August covered more than 60 per cent of Hong Kong’s estimated 110,000 subdivided units.
body: Housing Secretary Winnie Ho said the first six months of the Basic Housing Units registration period had brought applications covering more than 70,000 subdivided units from about 20,000 complete flats.

Speaking on a social media platform, she noted that the figure represented over 60 per cent of the city’s estimated 110,000 subdivided units. If around 80,000 of those units continue operating in the basic-housing form, the early response would account for nearly 90 per cent of that group.

Ho said the early-bird incentives had driven a marked rise in August submissions. Owners or operators who filed by 31 August and later obtain recognition will enjoy a full three-year waiver of the HK$3,000 certification fee. Those registering in the second half of the one-year window will receive partial fee relief.

Separately, 120 subdivided units have so far submitted applications for formal Basic Housing Unit recognition. The Housing Bureau’s dedicated team continues to process complete applications and place approved records online for public reference.

zh.headline: 簡樸房首半年收逾7萬個分間單位登記申請
zh.dek: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，截至8月31日共收到涉及逾7萬個分間單位、約2萬個住宅單位的登記申請，佔全港估計11萬個分間單位逾六成。
body: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，簡樸房制度一年登記期於今年3月1日開始，截至本星期一（8月31日）的半年內，共收到涉及超過7萬個分間單位，即約2萬個住宅單位的登記申請。
她在社交平台指出，香港現存約11萬個分間單位，首半年遞交登記申請所涉及的數目已佔全港分間單位逾六成；若以約8萬個分間單位估計將繼續以簡樸房形式營運計算，則佔近九成。
何永賢指，在早鳥優惠措施推動下，8月的升幅非常顯著。8月31日前提交登記申請的業主或營運者，申請獲批後可於2029年2月28日或之前三年期間全額豁免每個簡樸房3,000元的認證申請費。
簡樸房認證申請方面，截至昨日已有120個分間單位遞交申請。房屋局團隊會繼續處理資料齊備的申請，並盡快將經審批的資料放上網供公眾查閱。
